items.title: Rockwell Automation acquiring mobile robot maker AGILOX
items.summary: Rockwell Automation has agreed to acquire autonomous mobile robot developer AGILOX, expanding its mobile robotics portfolio following its 2023 acquisition of OTTO Motors. The post Rockwell Automation acquiring mobile robot maker AGILOX appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: 罗克韦尔自动化收购移动机器人制造商 AGILOX
items.summary_zh: 罗克韦尔自动化已同意收购自主移动机器人开发商 AGILOX，继 2023 年收购 OTTO Motors 后扩大其移动机器人产品组合。罗克韦尔自动化收购移动机器人制造商 AGILOX 后的消息首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: California DMV bars Waymo AVs from operating on the state’s freeways
items.summary: The DMV determined that Waymo's freeway operations "pose an imminent hazard to public safety due to recurring incursions by its vehicles." The post California DMV bars Waymo AVs from operating on the state’s freeways appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: 加州DMV禁止Waymo自动驾驶汽车在该州高速公路上运行
items.summary_zh: DMV 认定 Waymo 的高速公路运营“由于其车辆反复入侵，对公共安全构成迫在眉睫的危险”。加州 DMV 禁止 Waymo AV 在该州高速公路上运行的规定首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: Humyn Labs raises $47M to collect real-world data for robotics
items.summary: Humyn Labs provides data collected from real-world operations for frontier AI labs, robotics companies, and world-model developers. The post Humyn Labs raises $47M to collect real-world data for robotics appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: Humyn Labs 筹集了 4700 万美元来收集机器人的真实数据
items.summary_zh: Humyn Labs 为前沿人工智能实验室、机器人公司和世界模型开发人员提供从实际操作中收集的数据。 Humyn Labs 筹集 4700 万美元用于收集机器人真实世界数据的帖子首先出现在《机器人报告》上。
